result.effect: AOR = 2.18, 95% CI 1.20–3.96 for vitamin D deficiency

cells.quote: In multivariable logistic regressions, while there was no association between gender, father’s education, BMI for age Z-score, academic performance, and age (AOR = 0.59, 95% CI 0.48–0.72), 25(OH)D levels (AOR = 0.97, 95% CI 0.95–0.99) were associated with decreased odds of poor academic performance, and vitamin D deficiency (AOR = 2.18, 95% CI 1.20–3.96) was associated with increased odds of poor academic performance (Table 4).
cells.note: The deficient group had worse academic performance than the normal-status comparison; cross-sectional association does not establish causality.
